earnings.title: Samsara Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Q2 revenue of $508.4 million, representing 30% year-over-year growth and 29% in constant currency
GAAP earnings per share of $0.03, representing the fourth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability

quotes.text: Samsara delivered another quarter of durable and efficient growth, crossing $2.1 billion in ARR with 30% year-over-year growth for the third consecutive quarter.
quotes.by: Sanjit Biswas, CEO and co-founder of Samsara

outlook: Total revenue $514 million – $516 million $2.043 billion – $2.047 billion
